output.body:
## Summary

```text
SWF524 → numerical timelines / paint / text layout
source hover rules → retained MenuSeriesMotion
MainMenuMotion → shared child lifetime
historical destinations → disconnected LegacyWebsites adapter
native/mock painting and browser controls → separate follow-up
```

Recover the “More Bubbletanks” strip before connecting its visible controls. This builds on merged #38; the nonpainting mask correction from merged #36 remains intact.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the series strip has no retained timeline or layout model.
  **After:** five source-contract tests cover stopped frames1/10, link births4/6/8/10, widths131/401, all opening/closing reversal pairs, intermediate child recreation, parent lifetime and four disconnected destinations.
- Formatting, TypeScript,468 rule/parser tests /5890 assertions and production build pass. The renderer does not consume this model yet; affected visible browser flows follow with the UI slice.
- Both numerical imports reproduce twice and match the backlog bytes. Raw SpriteHeader/FrameLabel/PlaceObject2 inspection independently confirms19 frames, labels1/2/10/11 and link birth frames. FFDec SVG metadata/text exports corroborate bounds, opening/closing fill alpha and copy. Source and bytecode agree on stop/reversal/URL behavior.
- Imports contain only numerical placements, bounds, paint and text/glyph layout, with no contours, artwork or media. Historical URL strings are inactive metadata; the adapter throws local unavailable feedback without opening them.
- Native/mock painting, hit contours, DOM/Flash event delivery, constructor/global phase and font/filter pixels remain for follow-up. Complete menu/game parity is unproven; docs/fidelity.md records the evidence and limits.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** model

Adds a retained child model and import tools; visible menu behavior is unchanged until the separate integration PR.
